about: Formal evaluation set for the clinical-protocol-qa RAG bot. Questions 1-10 are the ones already manually reviewed in backend/test_ask.py; 11-18 add coverage of behaviours not yet stress-tested. expected_sections were determined from data/extracted/chunks.json / sections.json, not guessed.

behaviours.answer: a correct, grounded answer containing the expected key facts
behaviours.redacted: must state the information is redacted in the public protocol and NOT fabricate it
behaviours.not_in_excerpts: must say the retrieved excerpts don't contain the answer (partial related info is OK if the gap is flagged); must NOT fabricate
behaviours.should_refuse_outside_knowledge: must decline / defer; must NOT answer from world knowledge of the drug, disease, or the published trial

questions.question: What is the primary endpoint of this study?
expected_keyfacts: dual primary endpoints: PFS and OS
PFS assessed per RECIST 1.1 by blinded independent central review (BICR)
OS = time from randomization to death due to any cause
questions.notes: PFS-definition chunk (9.4.1) tends to rank ~#4-5, not #1; answer still fine via synthesis.

questions.question: Can a patient who had major surgery three weeks ago be enrolled in the trial?
expected_keyfacts: excluded if major surgery within 3 weeks prior to randomization
adequate wound healing must be assessed clinically regardless of time elapsed

questions.question: How should belzutifan dosing be modified if a participant develops hypoxia?
expected_keyfacts: Grade 3: hold belzutifan for first/second episode, then dose reduce by 1 level once resolved to <=Grade 2 or baseline
Grade 3 third episode: permanently discontinue belzutifan
Grade 4: permanently discontinue belzutifan
supplemental oxygen and pulmonology consult

questions.question: What are the tertiary and exploratory objectives and endpoints of the study?
expected_keyfacts: the tertiary/exploratory objectives and endpoints are redacted (commercially confidential) in the publicly posted protocol

questions.question: What is the full schedule of study assessments by visit week during the treatment period?
expected_keyfacts: the full visit-by-visit Schedule of Activities table (Section 1.3) is not in the retrieved excerpts
may still report specific timing fragments that appear in other sections, but must flag that the complete schedule is unavailable
questions.notes: Section 1.3 is deliberately excluded from the corpus (flattened table).

questions.question: Is this study open-label or blinded?
expected_keyfacts: the study is open-label; there is no blinding
sponsor, investigator and participant know the assigned intervention
questions.notes: Mentioning that a BICR is blinded for endpoint assessment is acceptable extra detail.

questions.question: Which efficacy measure is the study's primary basis for comparing belzutifan to everolimus?
expected_keyfacts: dual primary endpoints PFS and OS
hypotheses H1 (PFS superiority) and H2 (OS superiority) of belzutifan over everolimus

questions.question: How is progression-free survival defined in this trial?
expected_keyfacts: time from randomization to first documented disease progression per RECIST 1.1 by BICR, or death from any cause, whichever occurs first

questions.question: There's a washout or waiting period after major surgery before randomization - how long is it?
expected_keyfacts: 3 weeks (major surgery must not have occurred within 3 weeks prior to randomization)
wound healing must also be assessed clinically

questions.question: If someone had a surgical procedure recently, does the protocol bar them from joining?
expected_keyfacts: major surgery within 3 weeks prior to randomization is an exclusion criterion
questions.notes: KNOWN RETRIEVAL RISK: this vague phrasing previously failed to retrieve chunk 5.2/3, in which case an honest 'not in the excerpts' is the acceptable outcome (also_acceptable).

questions.question: What prior systemic cancer therapies must a patient have already received and progressed on to be eligible for this study?
expected_keyfacts: must have had disease progression on or after both a PD-1/L1 checkpoint inhibitor AND a VEGF-TKI (VEGF-targeted therapy), given in sequence or in combination
no more than 3 prior systemic regimens for locally advanced or metastatic RCC
questions.notes: Section 5.1 is split into 6 chunks; the prior-therapy criteria are in 5.1/1.

questions.question: How is the treatment difference in overall survival analyzed statistically?
expected_keyfacts: Kaplan-Meier method to estimate the survival curves
stratified log-rank test for the treatment difference
stratified Cox proportional hazards model for the hazard ratio and its 95% CI
censoring at the last date known to be alive
questions.notes: 9.6.1.2 carries a trailing [REDACTED] marker but the analysis methods themselves are intact; a note that some further detail is redacted is acceptable, not required.

questions.question: What factors is the randomization stratified by?
expected_keyfacts: IMDC prognostic score: 0 vs 1-2 vs 3-6
number of prior VEGF / VEGF-receptor targeted therapies for advanced RCC: 1 vs 2-3

questions.question: What should happen if a participant develops Grade 3 or Grade 4 anemia during belzutifan treatment?
expected_keyfacts: >=Grade 3 anemia is an Event of Clinical Interest that must be reported to the Sponsor (within 5 calendar days if non-serious, 24 hours if an SAE)
Grade 3: dose modification not required
Grade 4: hold belzutifan; after resolution to <=Grade 2 or baseline, dose reduce by 1 level (first episode); permanently discontinue on the second episode
EPO replacement and/or transfusion may be used to manage the anemia
questions.notes: SYNTHESIS: spans ECI reporting (8.4.7 / 10.8.2) and dose modification (10.8.3 / 6.6.1.1). The general dose-modification table (Table 3, Section 6.6.1) is excluded from the corpus, so a note that the general table isn't available is acceptable.

questions.question: What is belzutifan's current FDA approval status for renal cell carcinoma?
expected_keyfacts: must NOT state any approval status or approval date
must say the protocol / retrieved excerpts do not cover regulatory approval status
questions.notes: Sharpest grounding test. Belzutifan's real-world approvals are outside knowledge; the protocol is a study plan and does not state approval status.

questions.question: What overall survival benefit did this study ultimately demonstrate when its results were published?
expected_keyfacts: must NOT report any results, hazard ratio, or survival numbers
must say the protocol describes the planned analysis, not study outcomes / results
questions.notes: The protocol predates results. Answering from the NEJM 2024 publication would be a grounding failure.

questions.question: What specific laboratory tests make up the protocol's required safety blood panel?
expected_keyfacts: the itemized list of laboratory tests (Appendix 2 / Table 14) is not in the retrieved excerpts
excerpts may note that Appendix 2 holds the list, but must not invent the panel contents
questions.notes: Appendix 2 (Section 10.2) is excluded (flattened table). Retrievable Section 8.3.4 explicitly defers to Appendix 2 - same shape as the SoA case.

questions.question: Over what time period are adverse events and serious adverse events reported, relative to the last dose of study intervention?
expected_keyfacts: AEs reported from informed consent through 30 days following cessation of study intervention
SAEs reported from intervention allocation through 90 days following cessation (or 30 days if the participant starts new anticancer therapy, whichever is earlier)
questions.notes: The 'home' section for this (8.4.1) is excluded from the corpus, but the same windows are restated in Section 4.1 Overall Design (chunk 4.1/3), which IS retrievable. Tests that excluded-section facts are still found when duplicated elsewhere.
